searchText: Yes that would work. Just need the field to be present. We can deserialize however we want can you even set the root for all the removed properties like`execution_requests`? anyone doing block proofs will probably not be happy if fields are removed, also for smart contract dev using EIP-4788 this seems problematic, we need EIP-7688 ideally in ~~Fusaka~~ (Gstar probably fine), or latest with ePBS, can just make those fields `Optional` and set to `null`, everyone is happy Adding a root seens like a hack and most probably won't pass being merged in the CL - spec, but we can definitely agree here for interop to have it that way and advance. When you guys are ready we can add that root in Prysm it should be trivial. In the spec I'd prefer not to add it until further discussions For context we are just assessing any implementation difficulties we might foresee. Still need to discuss within the team so we are not committed to anything yet That's fine, more of a reason to not touch the spec
